description: This file contains helper functions and class definitions for setting up, managing, and cleaning test fixtures related to channels, users, teams, posts, and files in the Mattermost server, specifically for search testing purposes.

classes.name: SearchTestHelper
classes.description: A helper class for setting up, managing, and cleaning test fixtures related to channels, users, teams, posts, and files in search tests.

methods.name: SetupBasicFixtures
methods.description: Sets up basic test fixtures including teams, users, and channels with specific relationships.

methods.name: CleanFixtures
methods.description: Cleans up and deletes all fixtures created during setup.

methods.name: createTeam
methods.description: Creates a new team with specified name, display name, and type.

methods.name: deleteTeam
methods.description: Deletes a team and removes all its members.

methods.name: makeEmail
methods.description: Generates a unique email address for test users.

methods.name: createUser
methods.description: Creates a new user with specified username, nickname, first name, and last name.

methods.name: createGuest
methods.description: Creates a new guest user with specified details.

methods.name: deleteUser
methods.description: Deletes a user.

methods.name: deleteBotUser
methods.description: Deletes a bot user.

methods.name: cleanAllUsers
methods.description: Deletes multiple users.

methods.name: createBot
methods.description: Creates a new bot user.

methods.name: deleteBot
methods.description: Deletes a bot.

methods.name: createChannel
methods.description: Creates a new channel, optionally marking it as deleted.

methods.name: createDirectChannel
methods.description: Creates a direct message channel between two users.

methods.name: createGroupChannel
methods.description: Creates a group channel with multiple users.

methods.name: deleteChannel
methods.description: Deletes a channel and its members.

methods.name: deleteChannels
methods.description: Deletes multiple channels.

methods.name: createPostModel
methods.description: Creates a post model with specified attributes.

methods.name: createPost
methods.description: Creates and saves a post.

methods.name: createFileInfoModel
methods.description: Creates a file info model with specified attributes.

methods.name: createFileInfo
methods.description: Creates and saves file info.

methods.name: createReply
methods.description: Creates a reply to a post.

methods.name: deleteUserPosts
methods.description: Deletes all posts by a user.

methods.name: deleteUserFileInfos
methods.description: Deletes all file infos by a user.

methods.name: addUserToTeams
methods.description: Adds a user to multiple teams.

methods.name: addUserToChannels
methods.description: Adds a user to multiple channels.

methods.name: assertUsersMatchInAnyOrder
methods.description: Asserts that two user slices match in any order based on usernames.

methods.name: checkPostInSearchResults
methods.description: Checks if a post ID exists in search results.

methods.name: checkFileInfoInSearchResults
methods.description: Checks if a file info ID exists in search results.

methods.name: checkChannelIdsMatch
methods.description: Verifies that channel IDs in results match expected IDs.

methods.name: checkChannelIdsMatchWithTeamData
methods.description: Verifies that channel IDs with team data match expected IDs.
